title: Create a Complete Registration Form
description: Design a sign‑up form with various input types, labels, and validation.
problemStatement:
Build a user registration form for a fictional website.

**Specifications:**
- The form should have `action="/register"` and `method="post"`.
- Fields:
  - Full Name: `<input type="text">`, required.
  - Email: `<input type="email">`, required.
  - Password: `<input type="password">`, required, minimum length 6.
  - Age: `<input type="number">`, min 13, max 120.
  - Gender: radio buttons with options "Male", "Female", "Other" (group name `gender`), one pre‑selected using `checked`.
  - Country: a `<select>` with options "Select a country..." (value empty, disabled, selected), "USA", "Canada", "UK".
  - Bio: `<textarea>` with placeholder "Tell us about yourself".
  - A checkbox for "I agree to the terms" (make it required).
- Every input must have an associated `<label>` using explicit `for`/`id`.
- A submit button with text "Create Account".

Write the complete form inside a `<form>` tag.
hints: The country dropdown should have a disabled placeholder option: `<option value="" disabled selected>Select a country...</option>`.
For radio buttons, ensure they share the same `name`.
The terms checkbox can use `required` directly, no need for a pattern.
expectedOutput: A fully labelled, validated registration form with all specified controls.
solutionCode: Gender
